_source: Synthesized from garminconnect/garth's documented field shapes (activityId, activityType.typeKey, startTimeGMT, duration in seconds, distance in meters) -- NOT recorded from a real account, unlike garmin_day.json. This app's own convention is to record real trimmed responses rather than invent data; that wasn't possible here without a live sync. Replace with a real response the first time sync_garmin.handler's activity sync actually runs against a live account, per the plan's verification step.
